translation: At this time, if one adds a single clearing-and-descending herb to the lung medicines so that the medicinal force does not rush straight into the intestines, the obstruction above opens and the orifices clear by themselves. But the marketplace physicians all call it chest binding and use the bitter-cold, directly descending Lian, Lou, Chai, and Zhi, so that the blockage becomes still more severe and many die.

Moreover, this condition begins with fever, cough, and wheezing, so one first uses acrid-cool to clear and purify the upper burner, such as Bohe, Lianqiao, Niubang, Xiangbei, Sangye, Shashen, Zhipi, Loupi, and Huafen.
If the complexion is ashen and heat prevails with vexation and thirst, use the acrid-cold Shigao and Zhuye to clear and disperse. Measles-like rashes (shazhen) should also follow this.
